dialogs.text: Well then. What can I do for you, youngster?
We found the evidence.
Evidence? What evidence? I don't understand what you mean.
Evidence about the strange incidents in the village. Please stop pretending.
Nonsense! What kind of strange incidents could possibly happen in our village? Well, alright then, show me!
#(Hey {NICKNAME}, start with what was found near the well. Paimon's leaving it to you!)
This was found at the dry well in your backyard.
What is this? I can't read it.
Don't you try to fool me with some random things, youngster!
This was found at the dry well in your backyard.
This is... This is...
I can't believe that I was so careless when I was damaging the cart...
Hey now, you finally admitted it!
Since you have already gotten this far in your investigation, there's nothing for it. I can't hide it anymore.
In that case, you should have a pretty good idea of what happened.
A very good idea indeed! Grandpa Densuke, you...
Tried to rob a Shogunate cart, didn't you? And in the midst of the struggle, you destroyed the cart with a single punch, causing the goods to go flying into the gully.
Hoping to save themselves, the Shogunate's people threw their coin pouches into the well to distract you! And then, you locked the well up to prevent others from stealing the Mora!
Is that right?
Ah? No, that's not what happened at all!
Really? Paimon was gonna ask for your key and to have that Mora at the bottom of the well...
...Surrendered to the Shogunate! That's right! They were definitely going to be surrendered to the Shogunate!
*sigh* Well, this is what actually happened...

There was originally a group of young people in the village who got too bold after getting drunk, and actually robbed one of the Shogunate's cargo carts. These goods and the bag both belong to the Shogunate.
I couldn't let others know that this shameful incident occurred in our village. That's why I tried to cover it up.
What about your confession regarding the coin pouch...
He did that to cover up the truth.
That's right. I thought that you would stop the investigation once I confessed.
If it was just me... As long as no one else was affected...
Please don't report this to the Shogunate. This isn't about me saving face. I just don't want the entire village to be dragged down in the process.
I'm not interested in reporting you.
Yeah, that's not why we came here!
Oh, thank goodness! Thank goodness...
My conscience kept bothering me because of this cover-up, so I recorded everything in a diary.
I threw the diary onto the roof. If you really want to read it, help yourself, but please don't ruin my recently renovated roof.
About the lock on the well...
Yes, it was me who locked the well up. I also wrote down where I hid the key. Go read for yourself.
Grandpa Densuke, do you know anything about the Konda Village barrier?
Barrier? Oh, so people still know about that old legend...

They say that in ancient times, underneath the ground we are standing on right now, lay the roots of the Thunder Sakura. Indeed, this was one of the five roots that protect the peace on Narukami Island.
And guarding it and its barrier was said to be a responsibility assigned to us, the Konda Clan, by the Kitsune Saiguu herself.
But this was a long, long time ago. I hardly recall anything about the details.
I just want to know the truth...
Yeah, we didn't come here to report you!
The truth? Hehe... You young people these days are so interesting.
A bag for carrying Mora?
This...
...This belongs to our family. There is nothing suspicious about it. That's right, it's very normal!
He's so suspicious! Something's definitely off!
Now then, please draw the marking that was on it.
Fine. This is indeed not my coin pouch.
So many people have passed by my backyard, it's pretty normal for someone to have dropped it, right?
It's...
What's going on?
*sigh* Aye, you've seen through me, alright. Now, I was really tempted to take the coin pouch for myself, you know?
Oh Densuke, how could an old man like you have such mischievous thoughts!
Something's off here.
I—I already admitted my desire to steal the Mora. What else could be the problem?
Come now, I will surrender this coin pouch to the Shogunate.
Something doesn't feel right here...
Someone discarded this coin pouch intentionally.
Wh—What proof do you have for saying this?
The coin pouch is just one part of the mystery. We also found...
#...Found what? Hmm, your turn now, {NICKNAME}!
#({NICKNAME}, what did we find in the gully earlier... ?)
This was intentionally left behind on a rainy night...
You must be overthinking things, Paimon.
#(That can't be right! {NICKNAME}, was Grandpa Densuke really just after the Mora?)
(He must be hiding something else, right?)
Someone discarded this coin pouch intentionally.
You're hiding something else.
Please tell me how much Mora there was inside.
Hahaha, what kind of question is that?
There's no way you would know how much Mora was in there without opening it up either, right?
Now then, please draw the marking that was on it.

Oh, they're related alright.
Ridiculous! How can that be?
Unless... there's some kind of secret code on the Mora?
There's nothing on the Mora, but we did find something elsewhere.
We found this near the remains of a cart...
We found it on the tree branches at the entrance to the village.
